label: Capsule Bar
author: Conky-Studio
description: Fully rounded stadium/capsule progress bar. Cleaner than a square bar for modern HUDs.
lua_draw_body:
local x, y, w, h = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}
 local min_v, max_v = {min_value}, {max_value}
 local span = max_v - min_v
 if span == 0 then span = 1 end
 local pct = ((tonumber({value}) or min_v) - min_v) / span
 if pct < 0 then pct = 0 elseif pct > 1 then pct = 1 end
 local rad = h * 0.5
 local tr, tg, tb = {track_color}
 local fr, fg, fb = {color}
 -- track
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tr, tg, tb, {opacity} * 0.85)
 cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
 cairo_arc(cr, x + rad, y + rad, rad, math.pi/2, 3*math.pi/2)
 cairo_arc(cr, x + w - rad, y + rad, rad, -math.pi/2, math.pi/2)
 cairo_close_path(cr)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 -- fill
 local fw = (w - h) * pct + h
 if pct > 0.001 then
  if fw < h then fw = h end
  if fw > w then fw = w end
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, fr, fg, fb, {opacity})
  cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
  cairo_arc(cr, x + rad, y + rad, rad, math.pi/2, 3*math.pi/2)
  cairo_arc(cr, x + fw - rad, y + rad, rad, -math.pi/2, math.pi/2)
  cairo_close_path(cr)
  cairo_fill(cr)
 end
